author: Axiom II
title: Exploratory ConvRNN: DSConv Encoder with GRU Aggregator
abstract: This is a novel exploratory architecture designed to address the information bottleneck of pooling layers. This model uses the proven DSConv stack as a powerful feature extractor, but instead of pooling, it feeds the resulting sequence of feature vectors into a GRU layer. The final hidden state of the GRU, which captures sequential dependencies, is used for prediction. This experiment retains the 'Selective Fusion' logic for handling the CRI-Off task, applying the GRU to the appropriate feature vector(s). This tests if explicitly modeling sequential information can improve performance.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random, lax
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Sequence, Dict, Any

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 'd_model': 256, 'num_blocks': 5,
        'dilations': [1,2,4,8,16], 'kernel_size': 7, 'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'gru_hidden_dim': 256
    }

class DSConvDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int; kernel_size: int = 7; dilation: int = 1; dropout_rate: float = 0.1
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), feature_group_count=self.d_model, padding='SAME', kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,))(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h); h = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,))(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x + h

class DSConvFeatureExtractor(nn.Module):
    d_model: int; num_blocks: int; dilations: Sequence[int]
    kernel_size: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        h = nn.Dense(self.d_model)(x)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        for i in range(self.num_blocks):
            d = self.dilations[i] if i < len(self.dilations) else self.dilations[-1]
            h = DSConvDilatedBlock(self.d_model, self.kernel_size, d, self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        return h # Return sequence of features, not pooled vector

class ConvRNN(nn.Module):
    dataset: str; d_output: int; task_type: str; d_model: int; num_blocks: int; dilations: Sequence[int]
    kernel_size: int; dropout_rate: float; gru_hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        seq_len = x.shape[1]
        sgrna_len = 23

        # --- Feature Extraction ---
        feature_extractor = DSConvFeatureExtractor(d_model=self.d_model, num_blocks=self.num_blocks, dilations=self.dilations,
                                                   kernel_size=self.kernel_size, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate)
        monolithic_features_seq = feature_extractor(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        if self.dataset == 'CRI-Off' and seq_len > sgrna_len:
            sgrna_seq = x[:, :sgrna_len, :]
            target_seq = x[:, sgrna_len:, :]
            
            sgrna_features_seq = feature_extractor(sgrna_seq, deterministic=deterministic)
            target_features_seq = feature_extractor(target_seq, deterministic=deterministic)
            
            # Aggregate each path's features before final fusion
            sgrna_gru = nn.GRUCell()
            _, sgrna_final_hidden = nn.scan(nn.GRUCell, variable_broadcast='params',
                                            split_rngs={'params': False})(sgrna_features_seq)
            
            target_gru = nn.GRUCell()
            _, target_final_hidden = nn.scan(nn.GRUCell, variable_broadcast='params',
                                             split_rngs={'params': False})(target_features_seq)

            monolithic_gru = nn.GRUCell()
            _, monolithic_final_hidden = nn.scan(nn.GRUCell, variable_broadcast='params',
                                                split_rngs={'params': False})(monolithic_features_seq)
            
            fused = jnp.concatenate([monolithic_final_hidden[-1], sgrna_final_hidden[-1], target_final_hidden[-1]], axis=-1)

        else: # For all other datasets
            gru = nn.GRUCell()
            # Scan the GRU over the sequence of features
            _, final_hidden_states = nn.scan(nn.GRUCell, variable_broadcast='params',
                                             split_rngs={'params': False})(monolithic_features_seq)
            # Use the last hidden state as the sequence representation
            fused = final_hidden_states[-1]
        
        # --- Final MLP Head ---
        z = nn.LayerNorm()(fused)
        z = nn.Dense(self.d_model)(z); z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1) if self.task_type == 'regression' and self.d_output == 1 else logits

class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, model_instance): self.network = model_instance
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
        return self.network.apply(params, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    model = ConvRNN(dataset=hparams.get("dataset"), d_output=hparams.get("d_output"), task_type=hparams.get("task_type"), d_model=hparams.get("d_model"), num_blocks=hparams.get("num_blocks"), dilations=hparams.get("dilations"),
                    kernel_size=hparams.get("kernel_size"), dropout_rate=hparams.get("dropout_rate"), gru_hidden_dim=hparams.get("gru_hidden_dim"))
    return NetworkWrapper(model)

# Debug Report for Evaluation 287

## Summary
**SUCCESS** - Fixed critical initialization errors with Flax GRUCell usage. The code now runs without crashing.

## Root Cause
The original submission had two fundamental issues with Flax's GRUCell usage:

1. **Missing required parameter**: `nn.GRUCell()` was instantiated without the required `features` parameter, causing:
   ```
   TypeError: GRUCell.__init__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'features'
   ```

2. **Incorrect nn.scan usage**: The code attempted to use `nn.scan` with GRUCell instances, but `nn.scan` expects Module classes or methods, not instances. This caused:
   ```
   flax.errors.TransformTargetError: Linen transformations must be applied to Modules classes or functions...
   ```

## Fix Applied
Replaced the incorrect `nn.scan` pattern with the proper `nn.RNN` wrapper approach:

**Before (v1 - lines 59-63 in CRI-Off branch):**
```python
sgrna_gru = nn.GRUCell()  # Missing features parameter
_, sgrna_final_hidden = nn.scan(nn.GRUCell, variable_broadcast='params',
                                split_rngs={'params': False})(sgrna_features_seq)
```

**After (v4 - working solution):**
```python
sgrna_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_hidden_dim))
sgrna_final_hidden = sgrna_rnn(sgrna_features_seq)
```

### Key Changes in submission_v4.py:
1. **Added features parameter**: All GRUCell instantiations now include `features=self.gru_hidden_dim`
2. **Used nn.RNN wrapper**: Replaced `nn.scan(gru, ...)` pattern with `nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(...))`
3. **Fixed output indexing**: Changed from `final_hidden[-1]` to `final_hidden[:, -1, :]` to properly extract the last timestep across batch dimension
4. **Applied to all paths**: Fixed both the CRI-Off multi-path branch (sgrna/target/monolithic) and the standard single-path branch

## Technical Details
The `nn.RNN` wrapper in Flax is designed specifically for applying recurrent cells like GRUCell across sequences. It:
- Properly handles the cell initialization with the features parameter
- Manages the scanning over the sequence dimension
- Returns outputs in the standard format (batch, time, features)
- Avoids the complexity of manually using `nn.scan` with RNN cells

## Verification
Executed `monitor_evaluation.py` which confirmed:
- ✅ Code runs for 300+ seconds without crashing
- ✅ No initialization errors
- ✅ No transformation errors
- ✅ Successfully completed simple CPU validation phase

The evaluation is still running to completion (training takes time), but the critical requirement is met: **the code executes without errors**.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random, lax
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Sequence, Dict, Any
from functools import partial

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 'd_model': 256, 'num_blocks': 5,
        'dilations': [1,2,4,8,16], 'kernel_size': 7, 'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'gru_hidden_dim': 256
    }

class DSConvDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int; kernel_size: int = 7; dilation: int = 1; dropout_rate: float = 0.1
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), feature_group_count=self.d_model, padding='SAME', kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,))(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h); h = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,))(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x + h

class DSConvFeatureExtractor(nn.Module):
    d_model: int; num_blocks: int; dilations: Sequence[int]
    kernel_size: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        h = nn.Dense(self.d_model)(x)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        for i in range(self.num_blocks):
            d = self.dilations[i] if i < len(self.dilations) else self.dilations[-1]
            h = DSConvDilatedBlock(self.d_model, self.kernel_size, d, self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        return h # Return sequence of features, not pooled vector

class ConvRNN(nn.Module):
    dataset: str; d_output: int; task_type: str; d_model: int; num_blocks: int; dilations: Sequence[int]
    kernel_size: int; dropout_rate: float; gru_hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        seq_len = x.shape[1]
        sgrna_len = 23

        # --- Feature Extraction ---
        feature_extractor = DSConvFeatureExtractor(d_model=self.d_model, num_blocks=self.num_blocks, dilations=self.dilations,
                                                    kernel_size=self.kernel_size, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate)
        monolithic_features_seq = feature_extractor(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        if self.dataset == 'CRI-Off' and seq_len > sgrna_len:
            sgrna_seq = x[:, :sgrna_len, :]
            target_seq = x[:, sgrna_len:, :]

            sgrna_features_seq = feature_extractor(sgrna_seq, deterministic=deterministic)
            target_features_seq = feature_extractor(target_seq, deterministic=deterministic)

            # Aggregate each path's features before final fusion
            # FIX: Use nn.RNN wrapper instead of nn.scan directly
            sgrna_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_hidden_dim))
            sgrna_final_hidden = sgrna_rnn(sgrna_features_seq)

            target_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_hidden_dim))
            target_final_hidden = target_rnn(target_features_seq)

            monolithic_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_hidden_dim))
            monolithic_final_hidden = monolithic_rnn(monolithic_features_seq)

            fused = jnp.concatenate([monolithic_final_hidden[:, -1, :], sgrna_final_hidden[:, -1, :], target_final_hidden[:, -1, :]], axis=-1)

        else: # For all other datasets
            gru_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_hidden_dim))
            # Process the sequence of features
            final_hidden_states = gru_rnn(monolithic_features_seq)
            # Use the last hidden state as the sequence representation
            fused = final_hidden_states[:, -1, :]

        # --- Final MLP Head ---
        z = nn.LayerNorm()(fused)
        z = nn.Dense(self.d_model)(z); z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1) if self.task_type == 'regression' and self.d_output == 1 else logits

class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, model_instance): self.network = model_instance
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
        return self.network.apply(params, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    model = ConvRNN(dataset=hparams.get("dataset"), d_output=hparams.get("d_output"), task_type=hparams.get("task_type"), d_model=hparams.get("d_model"), num_blocks=hparams.get("num_blocks"), dilations=hparams.get("dilations"),
                    kernel_size=hparams.get("kernel_size"), dropout_rate=hparams.get("dropout_rate"), gru_hidden_dim=hparams.get("gru_hidden_dim"))
    return NetworkWrapper(model)
